kitDescription: Guilty is a Wind-element shotgun Attacker on Burst II. As she fires, every 6th normal attack grants her a self-only stack of "Mind If I Borrow This?", which duplicates 8.81% of the highest-ATK ally's attack onto her own; it caps at 5 stacks on a 10-second window that each new firing refreshes, so she ramps over roughly the first half-minute of a fight and then holds at cap. Every 12th normal attack she also gives all Wind Code allies (herself included) a 10-second 4.13% ATK buff and raises the stack count of stackable buffs those allies are carrying by one. Her burst strikes the single enemy with the highest final DEF for 284.32% of her final ATK. If her borrow stacks happen to be maxed when she bursts, that same target additionally takes DEF ▼20.25% for 5 seconds and a further 277.71% of her final ATK. In play she is a self-ramping damage dealer whose burst payload roughly doubles once she has fully stacked, with a small Wind-team ATK contribution on the side.

redAssertions: G6 'honours the max-stack gate' — ACTIVE branch: `rider at frame X fired outside every 5-stack window`. The S5 blind asserts the 277.71% rider may only land while the borrow buff is genuinely at 5 stacks; the driver's override carries no gate, so the rider fires on every burstCast including the pre-ramp casts.

G6 'NON-VACUITY: with the gate stripped it fires once per cast' — the gate-stripping counterfactual produces damage identical to shipped (ungated total is not > base total), because the shipped encoding is already ungated. The assertion is structurally unsatisfiable against this override rather than substantively wrong.

(Both REDs are the SAME single divergence: the unmodeled 'at max stacks' gate. Every other S5 assertion — 19 pass, 2 skip — is GREEN against the driver's shipped override, including all three G1 discriminators (flat-resolution, proportionality, highest-ally >= own-ATK floor), the G1 pulls/6 cadence pin that excludes both a per-pellet and a per-pull reading, the full G3 Wind-scope pair (strict-subset shipped + all-allies counterfactual moves teammates), G4 count/bucket/FB-exemption, and all three G5 structural checks.)

skill1.driverSaid: trigger {kind:'hitCount', count:60} — 6 shots x hitsPerShot 10, per the engine's +hitsPerShot-per-shot counter (dorothy 80-pellet convention)
skill1.blindSaid: S5 pinned firings to floor(pulls/6) with +/-1 tolerance, explicitly excluding both a per-pellet (~10x) and a per-pull (~6x) reading — GREEN
skill1.formulaCheck: SG 'normal attacks' count trigger pulls, not pellets; hitCount:60 is the engine's spelling of 6 pulls at hitsPerShot 10. Cadence claim is mechanically confirmed, not asserted.
skill1.explanation: The single highest-risk line on a 10-pellet shotgun (a 10x mis-cadence would be invisible in totals-only tests) and it is independently pinned by a cross-family blind test.

skill1.blindSaid: unique targetIdx of every borrow apply == [guilty] — GREEN
skill1.formulaCheck: Self-scoped ATK add enters guilty's own ATK bucket only; no teammate may hold it.
skill1.explanation: Both suites assert self-only from opposite directions (driver by equality, blind by uniqueness over a 4-slot fixture).

skill1.kitLine: Duplicates 8.81% of the ATK of the al
skill1.driverSaid: buff {stat:'highestAllyAtkPct', value:8.81} — resolves to 8.81% x max(all units' STATIC ATK) at apply time, feeding the flat-ATK path
skill1.blindSaid: S5 proved the emitted value is NOT the raw 8.81 (so it is flat-resolved, not a plain atkPct on guilty's own ATK), is exactly proportional when the authored % is doubled, and is >= the own-ATK-scaled reference — all GREEN
skill1.formulaCheck: A duplicated ATK amount is a FLAT ATK add resolved at apply time, not a percentage of the holder's ATK; the flat-add path is the correct routing. Basis is STATIC ATK per the caster-ATK convention — the kit says only 'ATK', so static-vs-final is genuinely undetermined by the prose and is carried as a flagged refinement in caveat 1.
skill1.explanation: Encoding is correct. DOC HYGIENE (not a faithfulness defect): the override's `note` MODEL section and its flag ⚑4 still describe the SUPERSEDED casterAtkPct proxy ('exact iff she is the top-ATK ally, else cold'), which caveat 1 records as replaced by highestAllyAtkPct on 2026-07-21. The shipped JSON is right and the note is stale — worth a one-line note edit so a future agent does not re-derive from the dead text.

skill1.blindSaid: unique maxStacks == [5]; every apply <= 5 — GREEN. S5 explicitly checked that a cap of 6 (i.e. silently folding S2's stack-count line in here) was NOT taken.
skill1.formulaCheck: Kit-literal 5. Steady state EMERGES from cadence + refresh semantics rather than being pinned; S5 observed peak stacks reaching 5 in its fixture, confirming the ramp completes.
skill1.explanation: The interpretation fork with G2 (author the cap at 6 to approximate the stack-count boost) was correctly NOT taken — the kit-literal 5 ships and the boost is recorded as unmodeled instead.

skill1.blindSaid: unique (expiresFrame - frame) == [600] frames — GREEN in both suites
skill1.formulaCheck: 10s x 60fps = 600 frames; refresh-on-reapply is the engine-wide stacking convention, and at a ~6s trigger interval it is what lets the stack hold at cap.

skill2.blindSaid: firings ~= floor(pulls/12), i.e. exactly half the borrow cadence — GREEN
skill2.formulaCheck: Same pellet-counter convention as S1, doubled; consistent with the S1 pin, so the two cadences corroborate each other.
skill2.explanation: Cumulative counter, so it fires across reloads rather than resetting per magazine — correct for an 'after N normal attacks' clause.

skill2.blindSaid: shipped holders are a STRICT SUBSET of a 4-slot comp AND include guilty herself (excludeSelf would fail); the {kind:'allies'} counterfactual reaches all 4 slots and moves teammate totals — GREEN both directions
skill2.formulaCheck: Element-scoped ally buff; guilty is Wind so she must be a recipient. Proven in both directions, so it is not vacuously green on a single-Wind fixture.
skill2.explanation: The driver's own fixture (liter Fire / guilty Wind / helm Water) makes the scope test degenerate to a single holder; S5's 4-slot fixture plus the widening counterfactual is what makes this discriminating.

skill2.kitLine: Increases stack count of stackable bu
skill2.driverSaid: UNMODELED — listed in `unmodeled.skill2`, flagged ⚑5 in the note with an A/B measurement recipe, and repeated in caveat 2
skill2.blindSaid: S5 it.skip with a GAP rationale: a buff effect declares its OWN maxStacks and there is no cross-buff / cross-unit stack-count channel in the schema. S2b (fable-5) agreed the ally-side is inexpressible and only speculated the self-side might be reachable via a resource pool.
skill2.formulaCheck: No primitive exists to raise another buff's stack count or cap. Approximating it by authoring guilty's own borrow cap at 6 would corrupt the kit-literal 5 and would still miss the ally-side entirely.
skill2.explanation: Correctly dropped WITH a flag rather than fudged. Note caveat 2 asserts a measured real effect ('bumps her own S1 stack ramp to cap one trigger early', guilty-sg-band probe) — that is the only unverified provenance claim in this packet and is the one item I would have the owner spot-check against the probe record.

skill2.blindSaid: value exactly [4.13], duration exactly 600 frames, target-scaled percentage not a flat add — GREEN
skill2.formulaCheck: Plain ATK% into the ATK bucket; near-permanent at a pulls/12 cadence against a 10s window, which is the correct emergent behaviour rather than a pinned uptime.
skill2.explanation: Exact. Removing S2 measurably reduces guilty's total in the driver's suite, so it is live, not decorative.

burst.kitLine: Affects the 1 enemy unit(s) with the
burst.driverSaid: target {kind:'enemy'} — the v1 fight is a single partless boss, so the highest-final-DEF ranking is trivially satisfied
burst.blindSaid: S5 it.skip: 'the v1 fight has a single boss and no enemy entity to rank, so the selection clause is unobservable'
burst.formulaCheck: Target-selection clauses are degenerate against a one-enemy fight; G4's one-hit-per-cast pin covers everything that is observable here.
burst.explanation: Unobservable-by-construction, and both the driver and the blind reached that conclusion independently.

burst.kitLine: Deals 284.32% of final ATK as Burst S
burst.driverSaid: burstCast -> enemy -> flatDamage atkPct 284.32; asserts count == burstCast count, bucket 'burst', fbMajorApplied false
burst.blindSaid: identical result from an independent fixture: exactly one per cast, bucket 'burst', zero FB-major applications — GREEN
burst.formulaCheck: Burst-skill damage rides the burst bucket; the cast is snapshotted BEFORE the Full Burst window opens, so the +50% FB major must not apply (repo prior 2). Trigger is burstCast, NOT fullBurstEnter — the nearest-wrong model, excluded by the count equality.
burst.explanation: 10 casts over the 180s fight in both fixtures; the line fires at the cooldown cadence, not merely present.

burst.kitLine: Activates when Mind If I Borrow This?
burst.driverSaid: NOT MODELED — riders are always-on. Recorded as ⚑2 in the note and as caveat 3: 'the at max stacks gate ... is not modeled (always-on) — a burst cast before the S1 ramp completes is slightly over-credited.'
burst.blindSaid: S5 made this the whole G6 claim and went RED twice against the shipped override — the single real divergence in the packet
burst.formulaCheck: None of the schema's gate keys (resourceGate, requiresTargetStatus, fbGate, swapGate, everyN, ownBurstGate, requiresCore, requiresShielded, bossElementGate, teamHas, formation, mode) expresses 'caster's own buff X is at max stacks', so the driver's missing-primitive claim holds against the gate vocabulary the blind writer enumerated.
burst.explanation: Documented, so DOCUMENTED_GAP rather than REAL-GOTCHA — but see gotchas[0]: the caveat's stated bound ('the very first burst') looks OPTIMISTIC. The ramp needs ~30 pulls (5 stacks x 6 pulls) and the SG runs ~1 pull/sec effective (9 rounds at ~1.5/s + ~3.0s reload), i.e. ~30s to cap, while casts land roughly every 20s starting near t=0. Casts 1 AND 2 of ~10 therefore land pre-cap, so the over-credit is nearer 2/10 of the rider, not 1/10.

burst.driverSaid: buff {stat:'defPct', value:-20.25, durationSec:5} on target {kind:'enemy'}; test only asserts recognized-INERT (removing it shifts totals <0.1% at bossDef=140)
burst.blindSaid: S5 structural checks all GREEN: the effect exists in the burst slot, durationSec is 5, the carrying block is enemy-scoped, the stat is NOT substituted with damageTakenPct, and no ally ever holds a 20.25 buff from guilty. S5 skipped the behavioural magnitude ('no enemy DEF pool to read against'). S2b (fable-5) called it a GAP that should not be silently dropped.
burst.formulaCheck: Boss DEF is SUBTRACTED per hit, so a 20.25% DEF cut is NOT a proportional damage increase — encoding it as damageTakenPct would have been the nearest wrong model, and the driver did not take it. At scope lock (bossDef ~140) 20.25% is ~28 flat off per-hit damage in the thousands, so sub-0.1% inertness is arithmetically expected, not suspicious.
burst.explanation: Encoding matches the prose exactly and S2b's 'silently dropped' worry is refuted — the line is present, enemy-scoped, correctly-statted. VERIFICATION GAP (not a defect): the engine emits no buffApply for enemy-targeted debuffs, so the driver's <0.1% assertion is green whether the engine APPLIES it tinily or IGNORES it entirely. S5's structural presence check is what carries this line; nothing in either suite proves the engine consumes an enemy-scoped defPct.

burst.kitLine: Deals 277.71% of final ATK as additio
burst.driverSaid: flatDamage atkPct 277.71 bundled in the same burstCast block as the DEF-down; asserts count == burstCast count and that removing it reduces total damage
burst.blindSaid: S5 confirmed the magnitude is encoded, is not marked as a core strike (no core-strike text in the kit), is FB-major-exempt, and — via the ungated counterfactual — that no teammate total moves. The two REDs concern only the GATE on this line, not the line itself.
burst.formulaCheck: Additional damage on a burst cast rides the burst bucket, takes no core multiplier absent core-strike wording, and is FB-exempt for the same pre-window reason as the 284.32%.
burst.explanation: The magnitude, bucket, core-flag and per-cast cadence are all correct; the sole divergence is that it fires on ~2 casts where the kit says it should not.

gotchas.summary: The 'at max stacks' gate on both burst riders is unmodelable in the current schema, so they fire always-on. Documented — this does NOT count against faithfulness — but the driver's stated bound ('the very first burst') understates it by roughly 2x: the S1 ramp needs ~30s while casts land every ~20s from t~0, so casts 1 AND 2 of ~10 land pre-cap.
gotchas.evidence: Kit: '■ Activates when Mind If I Borrow This? is at max stacks.' governs BOTH the DEF ▼20.25%/5s and the 277.71% additional damage. Driver: two unconditional {trigger:{kind:'burstCast'}} blocks, gate recorded only in caveat 3 + ⚑2. Blind (S5, claude-opus-5): RED on 'rider at frame X fired outside every 5-stack window' and RED on the gate-strip non-vacuity check, which is unsatisfiable because shipped == ungated. Ramp arithmetic: 5 stacks x 6 pulls = 30 pulls at ~1 pull/s effective (9 rounds at ~1.5/s + ~3.0s reload from reloadFrames 181) ~= 30s to cap, vs burstCooldownSec 20 and 10 observed casts in 180s.
gotchas.suggestedFix: No encoding change — a gate that does not exist must not be faked, and shaving the magnitude to average the over-credit away would be a fudge. Two actions: (1) tighten caveat 3 from 'the very first burst' to 'the pre-cap casts (~the first two of ~10 at the ⚑1 cadence estimate; ~1% of her 180s total)', since the current wording could let a future reader dismiss the gap as negligible-by-inspection; (2) if the owner wants it modeled, this needs a new gate primitive of the form {selfBuffAtMaxStacks: '<effect key>'} — a schema change, out of gauntlet scope. MEASUREMENT recipe for sizing: from a focus video, read the stack-icon count on guilty at the exact frame of her 1st and 2nd burst casts, and read whether a 277.71% popup accompanies each; that both bounds the over-credit and independently confirms the ⚑1 cadence tuple the ramp estimate rests on.

verdictRationale: 14 of 14 kit lines are FAITHFUL or DOCUMENTED_GAP (1.0). There are ZERO silent drops and zero undocumented divergences: every clause is either encoded, or recorded in `unmodeled`/`caveats`/a numbered flag with a measurement recipe. The one real behavioural divergence — the always-on burst riders — is exactly the divergence the blind caught (2 REDs of 23, both the same claim), and it is documented, bounded, and blocked on a schema primitive that genuinely does not exist in the engine's gate vocabulary; I rank it LOW and my only ask is to tighten its stated bound, since the ramp arithmetic (~30s to cap vs a ~20s cast cadence from t~0) puts the over-credit on the first TWO casts rather than the first, ~1% of her 180s total. Convergence is otherwise strong and unusually cross-family for this harness: the implementation is qwen's, the pre-op spec fable-5's, and the blind test opus-5's, and 19/23 blind assertions pass against the shipped override including the three assertions that actually could have failed — the flat-resolution of the borrowed ATK (a plain atkPct encoding would have emitted the raw 8.81 and died), the pulls/6 cadence pin that excludes the 10x per-pellet reading a shotgun invites, and the both-directions Wind scope proof. S2b's two PARTIAL disagreements are both resolved in the driver's favour: the DEF ▼ is NOT silently dropped (it is present, enemy-scoped, 5s, and correctly not substituted with damageTakenPct), and the S2 stack-count boost is genuinely inexpressible rather than lazily skipped. RECON_ERRORs: none — but note S6 is VOID (the blind override writer read the driver's committed file and self-reported), so there is NO independent re-derivation of the ENCODING itself; corroboration here is test-side only. Owner spot-checks, in order: (1) the DEF ▼ line has no verification path in either suite — the engine emits no buffApply for enemy debuffs, so the driver's '<0.1% shift' assertion is green whether the engine applies it tinily or ignores enemy-scoped defPct entirely; confirm the engine consumes it. (2) The override's `note` MODEL section and ⚑4 still describe the SUPERSEDED casterAtkPct proxy that caveat 1 records as replaced by highestAllyAtkPct on 2026-07-21 — the shipped JSON is correct, the prose is stale, and a future agent could re-derive from the dead text. (3) Caveat 2's claim that the stack-count boost was 'Measured REAL solo (guilty-sg-band probe)' is the only unverified provenance assertion in the packet. (4) The note's headline 0.981 solo real/sim validates S1/S2 and normal-attack magnitude ONLY — a lone B2 casts no burst, so nothing in that calibration touches the 284.32%/277.71% blocks or the gate gap; do not read it as burst-side confirmation. Discrimination: the load-bearing damage lines (G1/G3/G4/G6) each fail under their named nearest-wrong model, but the driver's own G5 assertion is green under both shipped and its counterfactual by design (it asserts inertness) — S5's structural check is what carries that line, and folding S5's four G5 structural assertions into scripts/tests/units/guilty.test.ts would close the gap cheaply.
